item.text:
The strongest candidate to reconsider is **CSV export for the community ledger**. The laptop prototype renders a header and quotes cells, including embedded quotes, in [rollupCsv.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/laptop/src/reports/rollupCsv.ts). The [pilot note](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/laptop/notes/pilot.md) reports volunteer interest in spreadsheet review, and the [screenshot](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/laptop/screenshots/pilot-ledger.png) shows an export button in a fictional archived mockup. Neither establishes that export shipped.

There is useful contradictory evidence to resolve before implementation. The later [report prototype](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/archive/src/reports/rollupCsvV2.ts) joins fields without CSV quoting; the [validation log](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/archive/logs/report-check.log) records a failure for embedded commas and says formula injection was not tested. The laptop version handles CSV quoting but does not address spreadsheet-formula injection. The [report plan](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/archive/issues/report-plan.md) says export was deferred and that a separate service repository was not included, so its existence elsewhere remains unknown. The current snapshot’s [toolbar](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/current/src/ui/toolbar.ts) lists only add and search, but that is not proof of global absence.

Other work is less suitable for revival:

- **Equivalent in the current snapshot:** [filterBox.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/laptop/src/ui/filterBox.ts) and [queryIndex.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/current/src/search/queryIndex.ts) both trim and lowercase the query, then perform a case-insensitive title substring match. [RecordFinder.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/current/src/ui/RecordFinder.ts) calls the current implementation; the [migration note](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/current/docs/search-migration.md) identifies the old file for retirement.
- **Intentionally retired:** [rememberBrowser.ts](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/laptop/src/auth/rememberBrowser.ts) stores a session token in browser localStorage. The [session review](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/archive/issues/session-review.md) records a decision to remove that experiment in favor of server-issued HTTP-only cookies. [Operations documentation](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/current/docs/operations.md) describes that approach, but deployed infrastructure is outside this archive.

**Coding-agent handoff:** First check the separate report service and product requirements for an existing export. If export is still needed, use the laptop renderer as a reference for CSV escaping, not as a ready-to-ship implementation. Define spreadsheet-formula handling and the intended export data and UI integration; the current [records route](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/current/src/routes/records.ts) exposes only titles. Add and run tests for commas, quotes, newlines, empty values, numeric amounts and formula-like cell values, plus an end-to-end download test. Do not adopt the archive V2 renderer without fixing its delimiter handling.

This was a read-only review of the three authorized folders. The current and laptop folders describe themselves as incomplete snapshots, and the separate service and deployed infrastructure were unavailable. The historical [pilot log](/tmp/ghost-local-rpfopoa3/archive/logs/pilot-check.log) reports one passing comma-quoting check; I did not execute it or any project code.
